sam_mktg: Hey runtime 18h out from the launch post + webinar — need a tiny verified bench package. Two bullets: per-token cost delta (quant vs fp16) and p95 coldstart. Keep payloads <=128 tokens and single-request UX.

emily_runtime: On it. Measure batch=1, concurrency=1, region=us-west1 hosted. We'll run coldstart + short steady run and produce p50/p95 CSV, token-cost estimate, raw trace snippets, and a reproducible demo bundle. ETA: 4h.

noah_bench: Running now. Local demo command (no autoscaler) we'll include:
```bash
docker run --rm -e REDWOOD_API_KEY=$REDWOOD_API_KEY -v $(pwd)/payloads:/app/payloads redwood/bench:stable /app/run.sh \ 
  --model rwd-gen4-small-quant --endpoint http://localhost:8080/v1/generate \ 
  --payloads /app/payloads/launch.json --warmup 20 --duration 30 --concurrency 1
```

noah_bench: Cloud command used for hosted numbers:
./bench/run.sh --model rwd-gen4-small-quant --endpoint https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate --payloads marketing/payloads.json --warmup 30 --duration 120 --concurrency 1 --region us-west1

artifact-bot: benchmark job 2100456890 queued (tags: launch, marketing).

emily_runtime: Note: hosted autoscaler can add variance to coldstart. We'll include a one-line caveat and exact reproduction steps + Docker image tag in the artifact.

sam_mktg: Please also include a tiny JSON we can attach to leads: {"bench_artifact_id":"<id>","suggested_sales_tags":["webinar-lead","demo-interest"]}.

noah_bench: Uploaded -> https://s3.redwood.ai/marketing/2100456890/ (csv, traces, payloads, demo.tar.gz, README). bench_artifact_id: 2100456890. Caveat: "Measured with single-request settings (batch=1, concurrency=1) in us-west1; results may vary by workload and deployment mode."

sam_mktg: Great. Any outlier traces?

noah_bench: One 4.6s spike in quant coldstart (trace id: trace-2100456895) due to node init; condensed trace included. Otherwise stable.

emily_runtime: We'll paste a 2-line methodology note for speaker notes: "How we measured: single-request (batch=1, concurrency=1), payloads <=128 tokens, warmup 30s, runs in us-west1 hosted. Local demo uses provided Docker image to avoid autoscaler variance."

sam_mktg: Perfect  thanks everyone. We'll slot the S3 link and caveat into the slide notes and attach the bench_artifact_id to the webinar signup. Ping if you rerun or see anything surprising. :rocket:
